name: 三姑六婆 Lite - 親戚稱呼計算機

android.desc:
How newlyweds him / her uncle and great-uncle woman?
To the New Year with a BB, what to call your brothers and sisters?
Gossip App to help you!
In operation of the computer input relatives, allowing you to quickly find relatives title.
Continuously updated information, if any mistakes, please let us know.

The App called "gossip", meaning thirty-three endless, endless sixty-six,
Chinese community reflects numerous relatives appellation;
But also to express the calculation title can also be as simple as calculated figures!

Lite Version permission requirements:
1. full Internet access to display advertising banners ←
2. Check the network connection ← detect whether the network connection
3. The in-app purchase ← optional Pro version features in App (for example: "Anti-query" feature)

* All the old features remain free to use.
* Database is continuously updated with the Pro version is no different.
* Do not want to use the user function within the purchase, consider buying the Pro version to use.

Instructions:
List 10 close relatives button on the screen, in accordance with the kinship order input, you can find a direct call.
For example: Want to know how to call his wife's brother, the first gender to "M"
Then enter "wife" "the" "brother" "=" you can find the results "Uncle."
If the relationship is too distant, when the program can not be calculated or not really call, it will prompt "No Information" message.

Button:
Relations button [father, mother, brother, sister, brother, sister, son, daughter, husband, wife]: Used to enter special relationship
Increase the level of button [a]: to confirm the relationship and add one more layer
Operational Results button [=]: The whole relationship is used to calculate the answer
Clear All button [AC]: to clear the entire term relationship
Clear button [CE]: used to reduce / remove the last layer of relationship

Translation Project title: https: //relativescalc.com/translate
Facebook page: https: //www.facebook.com/relativescalc

An app for Chinese relatives title look-up, for those who understand Chinese.
